author: Insight I
title: Insight I: Dual-Pathway Contextual Readout (Stagnation Protocol Idea 3)
abstract: This experiment tests 'Dual-Pathway Contextual Readout,' the third new idea under Stagnation Protocol I, building on Zephyr I's LN-ConvLSTM baseline (reproduced at 59.4%, ID 719; Idea 1 scored 59.9%, ID 725; Idea 2 scored 73.5%, ID 733). This approach enriches policy/value heads with a combination of attention-pooled ConvLSTM output and a global average-pooled ConvLSTM output, without explicit time feature concatenation in this version. This aims to provide a more comprehensive and context-aware input for decision-making.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional
from ray import tune

# --- Network components from zephyr/networks/cnn_convlstm_layernorm.py ---
class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    features: int
    kernel_size: Tuple[int,int] = (3,3)
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        gates = nn.Conv(4*self.features, self.kernel_size, padding='SAME',
                        kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1))
        gates = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5)(gates)  # per-pixel LN over channels
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)
        i = nn.sigmoid(i); f = nn.sigmoid(f); o = nn.sigmoid(o); g = jnp.tanh(g)
        c = f * c + i * g
        h = o * jnp.tanh(c)
        return (h, c), h

class CNNConvLSTMLN_DualReadout(nn.Module): # Modified network name
    """Residual CNN + ConvLSTM (LayerNorm on gates) + Dual-Pathway Attention/Global Pooling."""
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    conv_lstm_features: int
    attn_temp: float = 1.0

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None):
        B = x.shape[0]
        # CNN backbone
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = ResidualBlock(self.cnn_features_1)(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = ResidualBlock(self.cnn_features_2)(x)
        
        # Init/reset state
        if rnn_state is None:
            zeros = lambda: jnp.zeros((B, 8, 8, self.conv_lstm_features), dtype=x.dtype)
            rnn_state = {'h': zeros(), 'c': zeros()}
        if done is not None:
            m = (1.0 - done.reshape(B,1,1,1).astype(x.dtype))
            rnn_state = {'h': rnn_state['h'] * m, 'c': rnn_state['c'] * m}
        
        # ConvLSTM update
        (h_new, c_new), h_out = ConvLSTMCellLN(self.conv_lstm_features)((rnn_state['h'], rnn_state['c']), x)
        rnn_state = {'h': h_new, 'c': c_new}
        
        # Attention pooling (generates z_attn)
        attn_logits = nn.Conv(1, (1,1), padding='SAME',
                              kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(h_out)
        attn = nn.softmax(attn_logits.reshape((B, -1)) / self.attn_temp, axis=-1)
        H = W = 8
        h_flat = h_out.reshape((B, H*W, self.conv_lstm_features))
        z_attn = jnp.einsum('bij,bi->bj', h_flat, attn)
        
        # --- Dual-Pathway Contextual Readout ---
        # Global average pooling of ConvLSTM output
        z_global = jnp.mean(h_out, axis=(1,2)) # Shape (B, conv_lstm_features)
        
        # Concatenate attention-pooled (z_attn) and global-average-pooled (z_global) features
        final_head_input = jnp.concatenate([z_attn, z_global], axis=-1)

        # Heads (use final_head_input)
        z_for_heads = nn.Dense(256, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(final_head_input); z_for_heads = nn.relu(z_for_heads)
        pol_h = nn.Dense(64, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z_for_heads); pol_h = nn.relu(pol_h)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(pol_h)
        val_h = nn.Dense(64, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z_for_heads); val_h = nn.relu(val_h)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(val_h).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

# --- Hyperparameters from zephyr/submissions/submission_sota.py ---
BASE_SEED = 42 # Fixed base seed for stable 4-seed evaluation sets

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNConvLSTMLN_DualReadout( # Use modified network
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        attn_temp=1.0,
    )

# Use system default training_step and optimizer.
# training_step and create_optimizer will use system defaults unless overridden.
